inputs.name: complete_prefetch_service_organization_id
inputs.label: Complete Prefetch Service Organization id
inputs.description:
The FHIR Organization id associated with Inferno's simulated complete prefetch CRD server.
                Re-run the "Registration" group to provide this detail.

inputs.name: subset_prefetch_service_organization_id
inputs.label: Subset Prefetch Service Organization id
inputs.description:

inputs.name: order_sign_response_approach
inputs.label: Response generation approach for order-sign
inputs.description: Determines how Inferno will generate responses for order-sign hook invocations.

inputs.name: order_sign_selected_response_types
inputs.label: Response types to return from order-sign hook requests
inputs.description:
Select the CRD response types that the simulated Inferno CRD server will [mock](https://github.com/inferno-framework/davinci-crd-test-kit/wiki/Controlling-Simulated-Responses#mocked-responses) when responding to hook invocations.
              Because CRD clients must support the [Coverage Information](https://hl7.org/fhir/us/davinci-crd/2.2.1/en/cards.html#coverage-information-response-type) response type on this primary hook, Inferno will always include a Coverage Information response, even if it is not selected.

inputs.label: Custom response template for order-sign hook requests
inputs.description: Provide a [custom response template](https://github.com/inferno-framework/davinci-crd-test-kit/wiki/Controlling-Simulated-Responses#tester-directed-custom-responses) in JSON form for Inferno to use when responding to hook invocations.

inputs.name: cds_jwk_set
inputs.label: CRD JSON Web Key Set (JWKS)
inputs.description:
The CRD client's registered JWK Set, provided during the "Registration" group, containing
            its public key. Used only when a request was received with a JWT without the `jku`
            header. May be either a publicly accessible URL containing the JWKS, or the raw JWKS
            JSON. Run or re-run the "Registration" group to set or change this value.

inputs.name: order_sign_selected_response_types
inputs.label: Response types to return from order-sign hook requests
inputs.description:
